scripts.dev:backend: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run dev --workspace backend
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run dev:worker --workspace backend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace backend && npm run lint --workspace frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace shared && npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend
